summary.text: Gina Galfetti is a Republican state representative from Vermont's Washington-Orange District who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She owns and operates a business.

paragraphs.text: Gina Galfetti was born in and lives in Barre, Vermont, and earned a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Vermont in 2013.
Her career experience includes working in the legislative IT department during the Vermont Legislature's 2014 session and owning and operating a business.
Galfetti assumed office in the Vermont House on January 4, 2023, and advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026.
